openHandlePolicy.description: A Node gate that completes its entry module but retains active resources fails explicitly.

shardPolicy.stability: Gate order does not affect shard assignment.

groups.label: Lint
groups.description: Global strict compilation and source syntax validation.

groups.label: Typecheck
groups.description: Strict-core compiler, protected type regions and type-safety ratchets.

groups.label: Architecture
groups.description: Dependency, composition, persistence, repository, retention and error-boundary guards.

groups.label: Unit
groups.description: Focused domain, policy, mapper and application behavior checks.

groups.label: Contract
groups.description: Static and executable product, UI, workflow and API contracts.

groups.label: Integration
groups.description: Cross-module, browser-like runtime, composition and persistence integration checks.

groups.label: Route smoke
groups.description: Lazy route loading, navigation, query stability and shell resilience.

groups.label: Critical E2E
groups.description: Authenticated startup and deterministic critical-journey acceptance flows.

groups.label: Backend Contract Hardening
groups.description: Dependency-free P0 OpenAPI authority, registry, policy, workflow and fixture guards.

groups.label: Connected Acceptance
groups.description: Real backend generated-client contract and connected browser acceptance. Gates block without explicit external environment evidence.

excludedScripts.reason: Full Playwright browser suite requires provisioned browsers and a test environment; it remains an explicit release command.
Environment setup command, not a quality assertion.
Deterministic code-generation write command; generated drift is enforced by quality.api-contract.
Repository inventory write command; drift is enforced by quality.repository-inventory.
Connected Playwright convenience command; manifest-owned external acceptance is quality.connected-browser-e2e.

publicCommandAuthority.policy: Public commands invoke stable gate IDs or groups through this manifest-owned runner.
